captions.start: Stand tall, arms by your sides
captions.go: Raise your arms out to the side

steps.text: Stand tall with your arms by your sides.
Raise both arms out to the side with your elbows straight.
Stop at shoulder height and hold for one second.

safety: Only lift as high as is pain-free.

mistakes.label: bent_elbow
mistakes.wrong: your elbows were bent while your arms were raised
mistakes.right: Keep your elbows straight as you lift.

mistakes.label: shoulder_shrug
mistakes.wrong: your shoulders lifted up towards your ears
mistakes.right: Relax your shoulders down, away from your ears.
